title: Task G2 pilot maps
summary: The 2,000-voxel pilot region reconstructed four times with the same BFS seed order: the stored pilot (2026-10-10), the same configuration on today's code (the like-for-like baseline: the centroid screen became the default on 2026-10-12), the integrated configuration of Task G2 (SmoothCostRank E3+E4 tau 0.25 and OutwardSearch), and OutwardSearch alone. Wrong voxels (more than 1 degree from the truth): 37, 37, 42 and 36 of 2,000. The two OutwardSearch runs each lose grain 331 (a one-voxel grain), whose reseed took the outward-search path from a neighbouring grain's orientation.

figures.name: pilot_region
figures.title: 2,000-voxel pilot region, clean images, mc arm, reseed on
figures.caption: Clean images, mc arm, revisit and reseed on, BFS rng seed 0. Wrong voxels: stored pilot 37, today's code 37, integrated 42, OutwardSearch only 36 (of 2,000). Paired against today's code: integrated 15 fixed and 20 broken, OutwardSearch only 18 fixed and 17 broken; 8 of the breaks in each carry the orientation of a reseed that the outward search accepted.

notes: Clean simulated images (no realistic noise); one BFS seed order (rng seed 0) per run.
Wrong means more than 1 degree from the truth after cubic symmetry.
